title: Estrada, Marcoleta lawyers unaware of Tulfo's bail claims

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The lawyers of detained Senators Jinggoy Estrada and Rodante Marcoleta on Thursday said they were unaware of claims that the Sandiganbayan may grant bail in their plunder cases. “Senators Jinggoy Estrada and Dante Marcoleta will soon be set free on bail by the Sandiganbayan,” retired columnist Ramon Tulfo, citing a source, wrote in a Facebook post on Tuesday. “I would be happy if the tweety bird fed me [a] fake report,” he added. Tulfo said “a principal witness” against Estrada has recanted his testimony. Estrada’s case stemmed from an alleged “intricate mechanism involving illegal budgetary insertions and project […]...
